newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 16.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China has ordered all state banks to shift their state debt repurchase and spot trading to the Shanghai-based local currency interbank market after Beijing banned the banks trading state debt on local exchanges and state debt trading centres.

- China has issued a set of rules governing how financial institutions deposit their spot state debt for trading on the state debt repurchase and spot market, requiring that all state debt must be deposited at a newly-established central depository.
- State banks all around China have implemented a ban on their trading on the stock markets, announced by the central bank, the People's Bank, earlier this month.

- BUSINESS NEWS - Experts predict foreign investment will continue to flow into China steadily up to and beyond the year 2000 with annual foreign exchange inflow into China expected at $30 billion to $40 billion in the first few years of the 21st century.
